title: Use ReminderMessage in logDose()
name: logDose
description: Replace the inline 'Dose window open' / '<medication> is now eligible for another dose' strings with ReminderMessage.build(medication.name, nextEligible), so the notification states the actual due time and this logic isn't duplicated with BootReminderReceiver.
acceptance_criteria: All logic before the ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(...) call is unchanged (timing evaluation, insert, NeedsConfirmation early return)
Inside the `if (nextEligible != null && medication != null)` block, calls val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(medication.name, nextEligible) before calling ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule
ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(...) is called with the same doseLogId.toInt() and nextEligible arguments as before, but title and text now come from the destructured pair instead of literal strings
onResult(LogDoseOutcome.Logged) still called at the end, unchanged
exact_code:
fun logDose(
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
        doseAmount: String,
        acknowledgeWarning: Boolean,
        onResult: (LogDoseOutcome) -> Unit,
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val medication = medicationRepository.getById(medicationId)
            val mostRecentDose = doseLogRepository.getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId, medicationId)
            val timing = DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                mostRecentDose,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            if (timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon && !acknowledgeWarning) {
                onResult(LogDoseOutcome.NeedsConfirmation(timing.minutesRemaining))
                return@launch
            }
            val nextEligible = DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            val doseLogId = doseLogRepository.insert(
                DoseLog(
                    profileId = profileId,
                    medicationId = medicationId,
                    givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                    doseAmount = doseAmount,
                    nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible,
                    wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon,
                ),
            )
            if (nextEligible != null && medication != null) {
                val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(medication.name, nextEligible)
                ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(
                    getApplication<Application>(),
                    doseLogId.toInt(),
                    nextEligible,
                    title,
                    text,
                )
            }
            onResult(LogDoseOutcome.Logged)
        }
    }
